## Metrics come from the semantic layer, not from invented SQL

The chart below asks the `okurka` connector for the `okurka_units` metric grouped by month. The connector routes the request through the configured MetricFlow runtime so metric definitions, joins and dialect stay in the semantic layer.

```chart
type: bar
title: Units sold by month
data:
  metricflow:
    connector: okurka
    metrics: [okurka_units]
    group_by: [metric_time__month]
    order_by: [metric_time__month]
    limit: 6
    cache:
      ttl: 15m
encoding:
  x: metric_time__month
  y: okurka_units
axes:
  x:
    label: Month
  y:
    label: Units sold
```

```callout
kind: neutral
title: Reuse the materialized snapshot
body: "A later block can declare `data.cache.key: <key>` to render the same observations without re-querying the semantic layer."
```
